_about: Limits of the game. entities: the most entities in the world state of one map (Phù Đổng has about 120); the laws of the world check it on every step of every story (src/core/story.js). figureParts: the most parts of one figure of each kind at the fine level of detail (src/world/fine.js); all parts of all figures draw as one instanced mesh, so the count is the cost. frameTriangles: the most triangles of the world (the ground, the things, the smooth looks, and their ink) in the three by three chunks around the start of a map (src/world/chunks.js); a test checks it on every map.
